title: Kati Hermann — a centred CV in small type, ending on a warped name
note: The about page is one narrow centred column at 14-18px: "Born in Munich", "Raised between Turkey, Azerbaijan and Berlin", lead words in bold, languages in italic ("German // Native"), section labels in square brackets ([Education], [Hard Skills]) and asides like "[ In the process of unlocking Davinci Resolve ]". It opens with a yellow (#EEFF36) pill "aboutKati" in the heavy display face and ends with a passport photo, "Happy to hear from you!", and a square black tile where "KATI HERMANN" is mesh-warped as if printed on a bulging CRT, then an outlined TOP pill. Worth reusing: brackets and slashes as the only ornament in a CV, and one distorted wordmark as the sign-off.
